card.name: Mixed spots in anesthesia and infusion text
card.fires_on: Scattered marked tokens in anesthesia, infusion and device-instruction passages: commas in lists of airway sites, slashes in rate units, and partway through words like sorbitol, analgesia, epinephrine, DIPRIVAN.

modes.label: Punctuation and units
modes.description: A comma or slash inside a list of body sites or an infusion rate.

modes.label: Inside drug or medical words
modes.description: Partway through longer drug or medical terms.

card.writes: It pushes toward words about monitoring and feedback, though the effect is weak and mixed.
card.plain: It fires on scattered pieces of anesthesia and infusion text, with no single clear trigger.
